title: November 26 — from sweep to the living reader
summary: Five new repositories; 54 user-reported commits. Frozen map, downhill navigation, early geometry, conjunction, continuous workspace and external plasticity; preserve negative controls.

nodes.claim: Anchored alternating scalar-drive reader and shared frozen Qwen bank; swarm workbench.
nodes.survived: Separate anchor and probe; 8,000 cached word states, 128 PCs at Qwen layer 14; real user navigation and swarm traces; temperature port.
nodes.killed: One-sided blind sectors, dimers and narrow-band bias prompted corrections; no demonstrated road-transfer or reasoning advantage.

nodes.claim: Independent Python sweep; swarm, fields, developmental checkpoint and conjunction experiments.
nodes.survived: Temperature 95/100/98% vs cold 49/55/55% across three 300-pair sets; meaningful-map proxy emerges early; moderate cue blends unlock coherent new neighbors.
nodes.killed: Roads lose to shuffled/random long jumps; aversion does not transfer; step0 arrival 93% with final-map cosine .003; cosine oracle is not reasoning.

nodes.claim: Continuous recurrent state reads a weighted workspace without token generation; recoverable fatigue.
nodes.survived: Real-bank trap: 79 distinct entries in 516 beats, last new at 91; fatigue acts before selection. User-tuned intermediate regime balances continuity and novelty.
nodes.killed: Original temperature only reweights selected words; strong fatigue can force novelty at coherence cost; no validated task gain.

nodes.claim: Independent continuous associative reader with tags, fatigue, grain and temperature.
nodes.survived: 200 triples: state smoothness .94, no-fatigue stalls 94%; tag conditions share 15% of observed words vs 46% noise-only; swap retains history.
nodes.killed: Different tag is explicitly biased; word-chain controls differ in observations per beat; no native-Qwen comparison or task advantage established.

nodes.claim: Inherits CombinatoryPlaySol reader; adds external feedback, signed contextual memory, patience and sensory cue injection.
nodes.survived: 550-beat real-bank baseline: 1,776 distinct entries, coherence .4918, 5.62/12 retained. Patience relaxation and retrieval telemetry implemented; synthetic learning wiring passes.
nodes.killed: Toy static retrieval 3/3 vs learned 2/3 held-out; no demonstrated transfer or native transformer closed loop; no consciousness claim.

edges.why: Exporter uses Theory item frame and PCA bands; conceptual harvest, not model-weight inheritance.
Independent implementations share exported Qwen bank; Sweep explicitly imports it.
Reuses cached word-state bank; new continuous rather than discrete reader.
Explicit Unlock and checkpoint precursors; independent recurrent engine.
README explicitly incorporates Unlock definition and accepts Sweep banks.
Documented sibling implementations; not direct code inheritance.
AliveAI explicitly vendors the reader and carries forward the fluid-regime settings.

motifs.title: Frozen map, adaptive reader
motifs.description: Separate learned representation, navigation, workspace recurrence, recoverable fatigue and consequence-dependent memory. Navigability, coherent association and useful task performance are different measurements.
